title: [main] Bug 592028 Retention policy fails: Bin Mandatory must be equal to 'No' in Location. Current value is 'Yes'.
summary: Retention policy now works correctly with posted inventory documents by adding a FlowField for Bin Mandatory and proper table filters to prevent validation failures.
key_points: Added FlowField for Bin Mandatory to Posted Invt. Pick Header and Posted Invt. Put-away Header tables
Registered default table filters similar to Posted Warehouse Receipt Header to allow retention policy deletion
Prevents CheckLocation validation error when retention engine deletes headers with OnDelete trigger
Comprehensive test coverage added for retention policy upgrade scenarios
